entries.value: CJC-1295 is not FDA-approved for human use. Available as a research peptide.
CJC-1295 is prohibited by WADA under S2.

NSW Health reported (19 Oct 2026) 1,180 presentations to NSW emergency departments associated with peptide use between 1 July 2025 and 30 September 2026. The release does not break this figure down by peptide. The release names CJC-1295 among the peptides that products may claim to contain and states: "None of these peptides are currently approved in Australia for any purpose."

Poisons Standard (October 2026; F2026L01327; in force from 1 October 2026): "CJC-1295 (CAS No. 863288-34-0)" is a named Schedule 4 entry and is listed in Appendix D, clause 5, item 7 ("Poisons for which possession without authority is illegal"). The NSW release does not say which CJC-1295 form (with or without DAC) it means. Scheduling is implemented through State and Territory legislation. That CAS number differs from the one shown on this page (446036-97-1). This page does not state whether that entry, or the Schedule 4 class entry for GROWTH HORMONE RELEASING HORMONES (GHRHs), covers the Modified GRF 1-29 form described here.
